direct_checks.name: Wilson complex resolvent denominator has an exact radial and angular square decomposition
direct_checks.detail: |r exp(i theta)-1|^2=(r-1)^2+4r sin(theta/2)^2 exactly. The sine and exponential inequalities giving the all-energy norm bound are stated in WT-5

direct_checks.name: Wilson damped denominators have a finite physical-time limit while a raw transfer resolvent diverges
direct_checks.detail: tau/(1-exp(-tau E))=tau+tau/(exp(tau E)-1); the damped limit is 1/E, whereas the raw resolvent has a nonzero 1/tau coefficient. Lean proves tau/(exp(tau E)-1)<=1/E for all positive tau,E

direct_checks.name: Wilson carrier transport error budgets preserve a relative gap and a positive source amplitude conditionally
direct_checks.detail: Gap coefficient c spends 2*gamma*eta; source amplitude source spends error. Positivity requires 2*gamma*eta<c and error<source. Existence, completeness and matching of the Wilson shell are separate unproved premises

direct_checks.name: FINDING: a uniform vacuum gap does not determine the multiplicity or source totality of an excited shell
direct_checks.detail: Positive transfers diag(1,1/2,1/4,1/8) and diag(1,1/2,1/2,1/8) have the same vacuum gap log(2), but shell ranks 1 and 2. The second shell has a vector orthogonal to the stated source

direct_checks.name: Wilson nonnormal anchored activities satisfy an exact full-tensor bilinear certificate
direct_checks.detail: Four qubits, three overlapping pair activities, 4 nonempty disjoint families; the full 15-dimensional nonvacuum Schur complement has an exact positive LDL diagonal. Activities are nonnormal and annihilate both vacuum legs; no selected-source restriction

direct_checks.name: FINDING: right vacuum annihilation alone does not give the anchored bilinear bound
direct_checks.detail: F=|0><1| has F P=0 but P F=F. The proposed two-sided bound gives |<0,F1>|=1 <= sqrt(<0,Q0><1,Q1>)=0, which is false

direct_checks.name: Wilson complete-shell complex contour and Gram budgets are strict exact inequalities
direct_checks.detail: error=1/998; complex projection defect <= 15625/495351<1/9; Gram defect <= 13/32<1/2; contour left bound=4608/15625>0. These certify arithmetic once the analytic activity and synthesis bounds are supplied

direct_checks.name: Wilson disconnected-shell source matrix element excludes an independently rotated spectator
direct_checks.detail: Complete rank-two single-excitation shell on two three-level factors: marked diagonal=(t**2 - 1)**2/(t**2 + 1)**2, cross=0; every spectator-parameter coefficient vanishes
direct_checks.section: WILSON_SHELL; G18; G19 S2 and support lemma

direct_checks.name: Wilson Taylor range counting has a certified exponential envelope at every order
direct_checks.detail: 2(n+4)^3-(n+5)^3=n**3 + 9*n**2 + 21*n + 3, coefficients=[3, 21, 9, 1]; base orders 0..4 pass, so n^3<=4*2^n at every natural order. 3(24n+1)^3<=187500*2^n for n>=1; spatial support is an analytic input

direct_checks.name: Wilson holomorphic source Gram uses adjoint reflection rather than conjugating the variable
direct_checks.detail: Real-coefficient analytic source: J# J=[[z**2 + 1, z], [z, z**2 + 1]] is polynomial in z; J(z)* J(z) contains conjugate(z). This checks the continuation convention, not a Wilson model

direct_checks.name: Wilson matching after removal of its equal constant and linear terms has an exact shifted tail
direct_checks.detail: Dividing the degree-(M+3) remainder by u^2 gives (2B/R^2)(u/R)^(M+1)/(1-u/R); xi=t/(8 gamma) leaves coefficient t/4. The two equal Taylor coefficients and common analytic radius are required inputs
